Here’s what Jim Cramer had to say about some of the stocks during the Mad Money Lightning Round: 
Nike (NKE) : “They’ve been doing well even with the executive turnover.” 
Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) : “I’ve been behind this one for ages. It’s up 30 points since we recommended it last.” 
Aimmune Therapeutics (AIMT) : “I do like it. That’s an important niche business. “ 
Ingersoll-Rand (IR) : “I like Ingersoll-Rand. They work well at this phase in the cycle.” 
The Blackstone Group (BX) : “I’ve been a backer for 10 years. I think they’re real good.” 
Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) : “That one does real good. “ 
Newtek Business Services (NEWT) : “I don’t really understand it so I’m not going to recommend it.” 
Albemarle (ALB) : “I prefer FMC Corp (FMC) . That’s my favorite.”
